description: chat-server backend.rs SetError is a public type with #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)] but no std::fmt::Display impl. mail-server SetError has one (lines 126-134 of mail-server/backend.rs). A public library error-value type that callers may format in logs or error messages needs Display. The divergence means chat-server callers cannot format SetError values the same way mail-server callers can.
title: chat-server SetError missing Display impl
